# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/data-definition-language.md
# third_party/bigquery_docs/information-schema-datasets-schemata-options.md
# BigQuery answers in johejo-sandbox confirm enum option values have no SQL quotes.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_billing_physical OPTIONS (storage_billing_model = 'PHYSICAL');
SELECT CONCAT(option_type, ' ', option_value) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'scalars_billing_physical' AND option_name = 'storage_billing_model'
=> "STRING PHYSICAL"

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_billing_logical OPTIONS (storage_billing_model = 'LOGICAL');
SELECT option_value FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'scalars_billing_logical' AND option_name = 'storage_billing_model'
=> "LOGICAL"

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_billing_alter;
ALTER SCHEMA scalars_billing_alter SET OPTIONS (storage_billing_model = 'PHYSICAL');
SELECT option_value FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'scalars_billing_alter' AND option_name = 'storage_billing_model'
=> "PHYSICAL"

# BigQuery answers: the default model has no explicit SCHEMATA_OPTIONS row.
DECLARE result STRING;
CREATE SCHEMA billing_default;
SET result = (SELECT option_value FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'billing_default' AND option_name = 'storage_billing_model');
DROP SCHEMA billing_default;
SELECT result;
=> null

# BigQuery answers: NULL on ALTER preserves an explicit billing model.
DECLARE result STRING;
CREATE SCHEMA billing_alter_null OPTIONS (storage_billing_model = 'PHYSICAL');
ALTER SCHEMA billing_alter_null SET OPTIONS (storage_billing_model = NULL);
SET result = (SELECT option_value FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'billing_alter_null' AND option_name = 'storage_billing_model');
DROP SCHEMA billing_alter_null;
SELECT result;
=> "PHYSICAL"
